company.name: Ambuja Cements Ltd.
company.capacityDetails: +10.7 MTPA Commissioning in FY26 (Targeting 140 MTPA by FY28)
company.keyMoat: Low-cost captive power generation, green power share at 60%, pan-India logistics network, zero debt buffer
riskFactors: Raw material & petcoke fuel price volatility
Aggressive pricing competition among top 3 pan-India players
positiveTriggers: Commercialization of Sanghi & Penna acquisitions driving synergies
Renewable energy capacity doubling to 1 GW lowering power cost by ₹150/tonne
National Highway & Infrastructure Capex pipeline in Union Budget

piotroskiItems.title: Positive Return on Assets (ROA)
piotroskiItems.criterion: Net Income > 0 in the current fiscal year
piotroskiItems.explanation: Company generated robust positive net profit showing core operating viability.

piotroskiItems.title: Positive Operating Cash Flow (CFO)
piotroskiItems.explanation: Operating cash flow is firmly positive and easily covers operational requirements.

piotroskiItems.title: Higher ROA YoY
piotroskiItems.criterion: Current year ROA > Previous year ROA
piotroskiItems.explanation: Asset productivity improved through plant modernization and efficiency initiatives.

piotroskiItems.title: Cash Quality of Earnings (CFO > PAT)
piotroskiItems.actual: CFO ₹8,100 Cr vs PAT ₹5,920 Cr (1.37x ratio)
piotroskiItems.explanation: High cash quality indicates conservative revenue recognition with zero non-cash inflation.

piotroskiItems.title: Lower Long-Term Debt YoY
piotroskiItems.criterion: Current Year Debt/Equity ≤ Previous Year Debt/Equity
piotroskiItems.actual: Debt reduced from ₹45 Cr to ₹30 Cr (Debt/Equity: 0.00x)
piotroskiItems.explanation: Balance sheet remains completely debt-free with net cash surpassing ₹18,800 Cr.

piotroskiItems.title: Higher Current Ratio
piotroskiItems.criterion: Current Ratio current year > Current Ratio previous year
piotroskiItems.explanation: Ample liquidity cushion protects against short-term working capital requirements.

piotroskiItems.title: No Equity Dilution
piotroskiItems.criterion: Shares Outstanding current year ≤ Previous year
piotroskiItems.actual: Share count constant at 246.3 Cr shares
piotroskiItems.explanation: No secondary offering or equity dilution; existing shareholder value fully preserved.

piotroskiItems.title: Higher Gross Margin YoY
piotroskiItems.criterion: Current Gross Margin % > Prior Year Gross Margin %
piotroskiItems.actual: Operating EBITDA margin steady at 21.21% vs 21.20%
piotroskiItems.explanation: Green energy integration and lower petcoke costs defended gross profit margins.

piotroskiItems.title: Higher Asset Turnover Ratio
piotroskiItems.criterion: Asset Turnover Current Year > Asset Turnover Prior Year
piotroskiItems.actual: Asset Turnover 0.63x vs 0.65x (Impacted by massive CWIP capex)
piotroskiItems.explanation: Heavy Capex currently under construction temporarily dilutes active asset turnover until commissioned.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Price to Earnings (P/E)
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Trading at 33.7% discount to its 10-year historical average P/E multiple.
financialRatioMatrix.benchmark: Lower is attractive when earnings are expanding

financialRatioMatrix.name: Enterprise Value to EBITDA (EV/EBITDA)
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Clean EV backed by negative net debt (cash rich) provides immense margin of safety.
financialRatioMatrix.benchmark: < 14.0x is attractive for pan-India cement leaders

financialRatioMatrix.name: Price to Book Value (P/B)
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Replacement cost valuation makes current physical asset base significantly undervalued.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Return on Capital Employed (ROCE)
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Generated well above the estimated 9.5% Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC).

financialRatioMatrix.name: Return on Equity (RoE)
financialRatioMatrix.formula: Net Profit After Tax / Shareholder Equity
financialRatioMatrix.insight: ROE appears conservative due to unleveraged balance sheet and large cash treasury.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Operating EBITDA Margin
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Expanding EBITDA/tonne achieved through captive railway sidings and waste heat recovery systems.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Debt to Equity (D/E)
financialRatioMatrix.formula: Total Debt Obligations / Total Net Worth
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Completely debt-free corporate structure eliminates any interest rate sensitivity risk.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Interest Coverage Ratio
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Operating earnings exceed debt servicing obligations by more than 28 times.

financialRatioMatrix.name: CFO to EBITDA Conversion
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Near 100% conversion of accounting operating profits directly into bankable cash.

financialRatioMatrix.name: Free Cash Flow Yield
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Positive free cash flow generated even during peak ₹5,800 Cr annual capex execution cycle.
financialRatioMatrix.benchmark: > 1.0% during aggressive capex phases is exceptional

financialRatioMatrix.name: Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC)
financialRatioMatrix.formula: DIO (Days Inventory) + DSO (Days Receivable) - DPO (Days Payable)
financialRatioMatrix.insight: Lean 20-day working capital cycle frees capital to fund brownfield expansions internally.
financialRatioMatrix.benchmark: < 30 Days reflects strong dealer channel discipline
